summary: Local dashboard performance: bounded reads, optional code delivery, idle Assistant activation and a current navigation-only plan-feature projection.
noAssistantImpact: No assistant capability, tool, procedure, permission, entitlement, confirmation, schema or provider action changes. Assistant UI lifecycle pauses optional idle reads while hidden, keeps drafts mounted, prevents hidden auto-start and preserves pending-command finalization/durable run recovery. Existing fresh server checks, scope reset and command owners remain. Other changes are internal tracing/read scheduling/code delivery. No deployment. Dashboard shell now reads current plan features through one joined projection rather than the full plan catalogue; canonical feature resolution/fallback is preserved. Full billing/entitlement readers and command admission are unchanged.

docs.note: Tracing/read scheduling only; no schema or migration.
